title_en: A Day in the Life of a Travel Blogger
note_en: 一边A一边B means doing A and B at the same time: 她一边吃饭一边剪辑白天拍的素材 "she edited the day's footage while she ate." English usually uses "while" or an -ing form, but Chinese marks both actions with 一边; in quick speech it shrinks to 边…边…, as in 边走边记录 "recording as she walked."
